messages:
emily_sec: Short thread: we need to finalize per-repo KMS keys + admission verification before next week's audit. Quick sync?
jon_infra: I can own KMS templates. Proposal: cryptoKey per-repo, build SA gets cryptoSigner only, ops group gets limited signer audit view.
pat_ci: CI pipeline changes: syft -> cosign attest+sign (use KMS key) -> push -> upload SBOM/attest to gs://artifacts-sbom/<repo>/<commit> -> emit audit event.
maya_prodsec: Event fields we want: event_type, repo, commit, image_digest, signer_key_id, signer_identity, rekor_index, sbom_url, attest_url, build_id, ts. Retention 1y searchable.
audit-bot: vuln-scan: base-image-202410 flagged openssl CVE-2024-XXXX severity: high. Auto-flag created.
sam_sre: Rekor retention: 6mo hot + cold archive to GCS with 2y immutable retention. Admission webhook should verify cosign sig + Rekor inclusion; if missing -> quarantine label + notify infra.
emily_sec: Key compromise runbook: revoke key, mark images signed by key as suspect, force-rebuild affected repos, update admission webhook to block key, notify stakeholders. Who drafts?
maya_prodsec: I'll draft runbook with triage steps and notification templates.
jon_infra: I'll open INFRA-12345 for key templates + IAM JSON. pat_ci: I'll open INFRA-12346 for CI cosign/repro steps and include sample Rekor payload and cosign commands.
emily_sec: Action items captured. Meeting in 30 to review. If you can't make it drop notes here. :thumbsup:
